1.

O man, who walkest in the world And seekest in sin thy joy, Yet in the whirl of pleasures thou Canst not feel happy and satisfied.

C.

Arise, be free; the world cannot make thee satisfied, Jesus, Christ, is He who can give thee joy.

2.

Thou hast drunk thy fill from the wells Which the world to youth doth provide, But found that remorse and shame Were at the bottom of the cup.

3.

Thou hast found in solitary moments God spoken so mightily to thee, And said with a moving voice: O man, give thy heart to Me!

4.

Say, dost thou not now feel a calling To turn back unto God, And become a living Christian, And have thy joy in His commandments?

5.

Why dost thou still hesitate to seek Thy gladness in the beloved Saviour? He alone can give that bliss Which eternally abiding is. Arise, be free, etc.
